title: review findings (input of add_findings)
description: Recorded by add_findings in .brick-harness/gaps.json as entries with source finding (the one place findings live; the project's tracker takes them from there). A finding becomes work only as a failing test or target the measurer runs; ranking never drops or decides anything. rank_findings sorts by (impact count desc, severity S1..S4, evidence reproduced..theoretical, id); a missing severity or evidence ranks last. In gaps.json the evidence level is stored as proof and where as evidence.

id.description: Assigned from source, rule and summary when absent.

kind.description: missing-context: a builder needed something its work packet did not hold (feeds the owner's learning loop). Default other.

severity.description: S1 worst. Missing ranks last. On a catalog rule the program sets the rule's default severity unless severity_reason lowers it or reproduced evidence raises it (QBC-114).

severity_reason.description: Why the severity is below the rule's default: a file:line of the reviewed tree (other than where) that shows the rule does not apply at full weight, then the reason. Argued-only evidence is no reason (QBC-114).

evidence.description: reproduced: a failing test or run shows it; trigger: a concrete input that would; theoretical: argued only.

impact.description: Ids of the targets or acceptance checks the finding touches; more first when ranked.

rule.description: Catalog rule id or document rule the finding cites.

state.description: Default open. A re-review is given the open ones.
